{{otheruses|the monster|the historical spell|Reanimate Elf}} {{Infobox Monster |name = Reanimated elf |image = [[File:Reanimated elf.png|110px]] |release = [[7 January]] [[2016]] |update = Zeah: Great Kourend |members = Yes |combat = N/A |size = 1 |examine = This creature has been dragged back from the grave. |xpbonus = |max hit = 10 |aggressive = Yes |poisonous = No |attack style = [[Crush]] |attack speed = 4 |slayxp = 35 |cat = Elves |assignedby = vannaka,chaeldar,nieve,duradel |hitpoints = 35 |att = 95 |str = 95 |def = 80 |mage = 1 |range = 1 |attbns = 0 |strbns = 0 |amagic = 0 |mbns = 0 |arange = 0 |rngbns = 0 |dstab = 5 |dslash = 20 |dcrush = 40 |dmagic = 60 |dlight = 50 |dstandard = 50 |dheavy = 50 |poisonresistance = 0 |venomresistance = 0 |id = 7029 }} A '''reanimated elf''' can be spawned by casting the [[Arceuus spellbook|spell]] [[Adept Reanimation]] on an [[ensouled elf head]]. Reanimation can be cast on any ensouled head within a 31x31 area where that head was dropped by a monster. This will work indefinitely, even if the ensouled head is picked up, so long as it is not put into the [[bank]], [[trade]] screen, [[Grand Exchange]], or [[price checker]]. If the player has done one of these things, they will no longer be able to reanimate the creature in the area where it was killed, but can still reanimate it within range of the [[Dark Altar]]. Killing the creature will grant the player 754 [[Prayer]] [[experience]]. ==Prayer info== {{Prayer info |name = Reanimated elf |level = 1 |xp = 754 |type = reanimated }} ==Changes== {{Subject changes header}} {{Subject changes |date = 7 November 2019 |update = Bounty Hunter Rework |change = Some stretching during the death animation of ensouled elves has been fixed. }} {{Subject changes |date = 2 October 2019 |update = The Fremennik Exiles Feedback Changes |change = The reanimated elf was given another minor graphical update. }} {{Subject changes |date = 25 July 2019 |update = Song of the Elves |change = The reanimated elf was given a [[graphical update]]. }} {{Subject changes footer}} ===Gallery (historical)=== {|style="text-align: center" cellpadding="15" |[[File:Reanimated elf v1.png|center|300x150px]] |[[File:Reanimated elf v2.png|center|300x150px]] |[[File:Reanimated elf.png|center|300x150px]] |- |7 January 2016 –
